GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Raced wide and without cover throughout the event. When questioned, rider advised that his mount made the 800m turn awkwardly and raced quite keen throughout the event. He added that his mount failed to respond to his urgings in the home straight. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted in on jumping and was contacted on the hindquarter. When questioned re his riding over the concluding stages, Rdr stated that his mount raced greenly in the home straight and approaching the winning post, it changed stride and became awkward in its action and consequently he did not ride the gelding fully to the end of the race. Stewards accepted the riders explanation.
